verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions document scheduled executions as a trigger type and explicitly list cron jobs among supported workloads, so recurring jobs are a first-party capability. The CLI and MCP server can create and deploy Functions, but setting schedules through them isn't shown. missing for 10: detailed schedule/cron configuration docs, multi-step workflow orchestration, evidence that agents can configure schedules via MCP/CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
